title: An Grianan Theatre
scope: The standing Port Road theatre in Letterkenny. The model uses the cleared 2007 image for the signature glass foyer and entrance, and the mapped outline for the connected auditorium and backstage volumes.
limitations: The front colours and entrance represent the cleared 2007 image before the 2014 renovations.
The rear and secondary wings follow the mapped outline. Unpublished exterior heights, cladding and openings are approximate.
